story_type: bulk carrier plowing through heavy seas far offshore, helicopter medevac seen air to air
hook: This ship was burying its bow, 300 miles out.
narration: This cargo ship was burying its bow, three hundred miles off San Diego.
One of its crew was in severe pain and needed a hospital.
A Coast Guard aircrew from Sector San Diego flew out to the bulk carrier.
This far out there is nowhere to land. Every minute spent hovering burns fuel needed for the flight home.
[short pause] The ship kept rolling as the helicopter moved in over its deck.
outcome: And the crewman was flown back to San Diego for medical care.
title: Ship in heavy seas, 300 miles out
description:
On April 16, 2013, a Coast Guard Sector San Diego aircrew medically evacuated a crewman with severe abdominal pain from the bulk cargo ship As Elysia, about 300 miles from San Diego, and flew him to San Diego for medical care.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video, Sector San Diego, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/286997
